taskName: WP-T2-03: Fenced Blackboard Shared Memory Engine

featuresDelivered: IBlackboard AST interface fully implemented with FencedBlackboardEntry
RBAC enforcement across 6 Swarm Namespaces: system:*, security:*, remediation:*, tasks:*, telemetry:*, shared:*
Optimistic Concurrency Control (OCC) with expectedVersion validation and ERR_OCC_VERSION_MISMATCH
Leased Lock clamping bounded in safe [1s, 5s] interval
Monotonic Fencing Token generation formatted as ${key}:${version}:${seq}
Zero ghost/phantom entry leaks upon lock release or natural lock expiration on unwritten keys
Bidirectional state isolation preventing input and output memory mutation bleed via structuredClone
Advanced query filtering & pagination supporting BlackboardQueryOptions (authorId, includeLocked, limit, offset)
Non-positive TTL handling immediately expiring entries rather than creating immortal records
Administrative supervisor/system force-release lock bypass for dead/quarantined worker remediation
Strict key and authorId boundary validation throwing ERR_INVALID_KEY and ERR_RBAC_PERMISSION_DENIED
